claims: QVC Group filed for voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy on April 16, 2026, in the Southern District of Texas.
QVC Group filed for voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy to restructure and cut its debt from $6.6 billion to $1.3 billion.
QVC Group expects to continue operations, including live shows.
QVC Group aims to exit bankruptcy within 90 days.
The restructuring applies only to U.S. operations.
QVC aims to continue normal operations with sufficient liquidity during this process.
QVC Group has a pre-packaged agreement with lenders.
Major creditors, including vendors like Skechers and Clarks, are expected to be paid in full.
The filing is attributed to high debt loads.
The filing is attributed to a decline in traditional TV viewership to online platforms.
QVC has stated that there are no planned interruptions to, or shutdowns of, its daily, live-shopping programming.
QVC.com and HSN.com are expected to continue functioning as normal.
